K3BlochGroups:V.3/pre-bloch-group.statement: The pre-Bloch group P(F) of a field F: the free abelian group on F \ {0,1} modulo the five-term relations, with the convention for the degenerate symbols recorded.

K3BlochGroups:V.3/bloch-group.statement: The Bloch group B(F): the kernel of P(F) → ∧²(F^×) (with the source's convention on 2-torsion or tensoring), [x] ↦ x ∧ (1 − x).

K3BlochGroups:V.3/five-term-relation.statement: The five-term relation in P(F), in the source's normalisation.

K3BlochGroups:V.3/bloch-wigner-dilogarit.statement: The Bloch–Wigner function D: P¹(C) → R, D(z) = Im Li₂(z) + arg(1 − z) log|z|, real-analytic off {0, 1, ∞} and continuous on P¹(C).

K3BlochGroups:V.3/bloch-wigner-five-term.statement: D satisfies the five-term relation, hence induces a homomorphism P(C) → R.

K3BlochGroups:V.4/suslin-exact-sequence.statement: Suslin's exact sequence 0 → Tor(F^×, F^×)~ → K_3^ind(F) → B(F) → 0 for infinite fields, in the source's precise form.

Polylogarithms:P.1/classical-polylogarit.statement: The classical polylogarithm Li_n(z) = Σ z^k / k^n for |z| < 1 and its analytic continuation.

Polylogarithms:P.1/single-valued-polylog.statement: Zagier's single-valued polylogarithm P_n (or L_n), real-analytic on P¹(C) minus {0, 1, ∞}.

Polylogarithms:P.4/higher-bloch-group.statement: Zagier's higher Bloch groups B_n(F) defined via functional equations of polylogarithms, with the convention recorded.

Polylogarithms:P.3/polylogarithmic-compl.statement: Goncharov's polylogarithmic complexes Γ(F, n) for n ≤ 3 and the groups B_n(F) they use.

BorelRegulators:R.4/borel-regulator.statement: The Borel regulator K_{2n−1}(O_F) → R^{d_n}, with its normalisation.

BorelRegulators:R.3/borel-rank-theorem.statement: Borel's theorem: the rank of K_{2n−1}(O_F) is r₁ + r₂ (n odd, n > 1) or r₂ (n even).
